name: ALY, the Hon. Dr Anne

headline.note: Added AMEP and TAFE teaching, RTO management, named consulting affiliation and 2009–2015 CAAR governance. The 45th Parliament interests statement now fixes PaVE chair cessation at 6 August 2016 and documents post-election ECU/Curtin adjunct affiliations; a later legal analysis confirms the substantive ECU professorship was relinquished before nomination. Exact government and university contracts, continuous intervals, hours and leave remain unmapped, so no duration is manufactured.

career_spells.employer: Department of Education and Training (Western Australia)
career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography records this Western Australian government role in 2001-02. Exact appointment and cessation dates, hours and leave are not published. SBS 2016 reports transition into full-time government policy work, but does not map that status or leave to this exact contract or later appointments. Positive full-time evidence retained without asserting continuous 2001–2008 full-time service.
career_spells.counting_note: Public-sector employment is supported, but substantive full-time status and exact duration are not established.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records the role from 2002 to 2007; contemporary biographical material independently identifies Aly as a former senior policy officer in the office. Exact transfer date, hours and leave are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Public-sector employment is supported, but a countable full-time interval is not.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography records this 2007-09 position, corroborated by the 2011 WA Women's Hall of Fame biography. Exact appointment/cessation, hours and leave are not published. Correction 2026-10-02: refreshed official indexed biography gives 2007–2008, not the earlier record’s 2007–2009 attribution. Earlier endpoint withdrawn; exact day and leave unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: A management title does not prove substantive full-time status; exact boundaries are also absent.

career_spells.role: Postdoctoral research fellow and senior lecturer/researcher
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography places Aly in university teaching from 2009; a 2010 journal biography identifies her as a postdoctoral research fellow at ECU and a 2011 contemporary profile calls her a senior lecturer and researcher there. Published material does not resolve the title transition, contract, hours or leave.
career_spells.counting_note: The work was at a WA public university, but the evidence is insufficient to calculate a full-time interval.

career_spells.employer: Curtin University and Edith Cowan University
career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography combines senior-lecturer appointments at Curtin and ECU from 2011 to 2014. Curtin contemporaneously described Aly as a research fellow in 2011. Employer-specific dates, simultaneous versus successive status, hours and leave are unresolved. Curtin release is dated 1 April 2011 and explicitly welcomes her recent move to Curtin. Earlier source locator incorrectly said 24 June; actual appointment date remains unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Both institutions were WA public universities, but overlapping employer attribution and full-time status are insufficiently documented.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official chronology records an associate-professor role in 2014-15; contemporary sources continued to describe Aly as a Curtin research fellow. Exact promotion, appointment, workload and cessation are not published.
career_spells.counting_note: Public-university employment is supported, but not a sufficiently bounded full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: ECU's 2015 annual report identifies Aly as one of its first Professorial Research Fellow appointments. Contemporary election coverage described her as an ECU professor in May 2016. A 2018 legal analysis reports that Labor's eligibility vetting made Aly quit the ECU professorship before her federal nomination, but gives no letter date or workload. The later adjunct affiliation is recorded separately and is not treated as continuation of substantive employment.
career_spells.counting_note: A professorial title does not by itself prove substantive full-time status, and the 2016 transition to candidacy and elected office is not precisely evidenced.

career_spells.evidence_note: Biographical and contemporary reporting identify Aly as founder and head of the counter-extremism nonprofit. Her signed 45th Parliament interests statement records resignation as founding chair on 6 August 2016. No paid employment, hours or remuneration are established; the activity overlapped university appointments.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit governance/advocacy is excluded unless substantive paid employment is documented.

career_spells.evidence_note: ABC reporting records Aly's candidacy announcement on 29 January 2016 and election on 2 July 2016. No paid party employment is established.
career_spells.counting_note: Candidate and party activity is excluded.

career_spells.role: Member of the House of Representatives for Cowan
career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography records election for Cowan on 2 July 2016 and subsequent re-elections.

career_spells.employer: Adult Migrant English Program provider, employer unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: First-person AMEP teaching confirmed; SBS describes casual teaching before full-time policy work. Provider and dates unknown; government funding does not identify employer control or hours.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: First-person parliamentary statement confirms TAFE teaching, but no campus, dates or hours. May overlap AMEP role; do not count twice.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: First-person statement confirms RTO management; public/private/nonprofit control, contracts, dates and relationship to listed roles unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: Company lists Aly among consultants; not enough evidence for employee versus contractor, remuneration, hours, start/end or link to separately reported own business from 2011.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: Primary university biography dates first appointment to 2009; official table gives second term 16 December 2012–15 December 2015 scheduled, minister confirms concluding term November 2015. Governance, not substantive public-service employment; exact actual first/last days and remuneration unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: Aly's signed 45th Parliament interests statement, lodged 16 September 2016 and declaring interests as at election day, lists Adjunct Professor at ECU after the substantive professorship had been relinquished. The document does not give appointment dates, pay or workload.
career_spells.counting_note: An adjunct affiliation without evidence of substantive paid employment or hours is excluded from headline employment years.

career_spells.evidence_note: Aly's signed 45th Parliament interests statement, lodged 16 September 2016 and declaring interests as at election day, lists Adjunct Associate Professor at Curtin. The document does not give appointment dates, pay or workload.
career_spells.counting_note: An adjunct affiliation without evidence of substantive paid employment or hours is excluded from headline employment years.

research_notes: Identify Aly's reported part-time English-teaching work while studying, including employer, dates, hours and leave; it is not sufficiently evidenced for a spell here.
Obtain appointment instruments, exact dates, hours and leave for the Department of Education and Training, Office of Multicultural Interests and Equal Opportunity Commission roles.

Disaggregate the official combined Curtin/ECU senior-lecturer entry and reconcile postdoctoral fellow, research fellow, lecturer, associate-professor and professorial-research-fellow titles and overlaps.
Identify the policy-consulting business reported from 2011, its entity, clients, paid activity, hours and overlap with university work.
Establish whether PaVE work or UN/board advisory activity was paid substantive employment rather than governance or professional service.
Obtain 2016 university leave/cessation and campaign arrangements.

Follow-up 2026-10-02: first-person speeches establish previously missing teaching and RTO management; consultant company identifies Phoenix affiliation. SBS supplies positive full-time policy-work evidence requiring contract/date mapping. CAAR second-term schedule and 2015 conclusion documented.

Remaining: identify AMEP/TAFE/RTO employers and role overlap; find first full-time policy appointment and later status changes/leave; EOC 2008 cessation, OMI 2002 versus secondary 2003 commencement; ECU/Curtin precise transfers; own consultancy from 2011 versus Phoenix association; 2016 campaign leave.
Recovered APH 403/robots and member speech Internal Error handled with visible official index and accessible first-person transcripts. No access bypass. Source timing and date conflicts retained.

Follow-up 2026-10-03: official interests evidence resolves PaVE chair cessation to 6 August 2016 and confirms separate post-election ECU/Curtin adjunct affiliations. Inside Story reports the substantive ECU professorship was relinquished before nomination, reconciling it with those adjunct titles; the exact resignation letter date, campaign leave, pay and workload remain unavailable.
